items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: Snake Hips was in there that day, in the cabaret, and I went over there and started doing my business

ctx.x: So naturally, I was with him, and we three were in there drinking, and eating these ribs, and I was a little off, you know? So I got into a taxicab to go to the hotel, and when I got there, I couldn't see the hotel; I told the taxi driver to keep on going, you know? So when I came back, I went to the cabaret that was downstairs in the hotel, it's a colored hotel, you know?

I went downstairs, and I don't know how I got so to tell him to play some Spanish music, but I did -- a rumba, or something, and I got one of the entertainers and I said, 'Would you like to dance with me?' But you do what I tell you. You know.
